comments.body:
## Validation

### Deep review update — 25 October 2026

**Draft; merge blocked by open P2 S2.5-R1.** The complete stack review at implementation head `806ccc573c6ae09c411a47a755d6dd9316343f8f` found that this coordinator's safety scan uses display pages and fetches unused email for every member. With 100 active memberships and simulated successful 300 ms user lookups, it reaches 30 seconds before DELETE, returns unknown, keeps the pending row and makes the next request busy. Independent and manager probes agree. This is conditional simulated-latency evidence, not a production benchmark or a last-Admin bypass.

The [repair ticket](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0530dd634fe8302b55d4a0669463ef733199cc40/docs/design/organization-admin-plan.md#s25-r1--read-safety-facts-without-display-hydration) removes per-member display work while preserving current safety facts, bounds, intent and receipt rules. No repair is implemented and this PR head is unchanged. The later UI commit extracts the target-support predicate but does not remove the affected page scan. [Current review evidence](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/94229f1c8309b33cfe5957dc894273bfd16a08d9/review-evidence/s2-5-stack-review/0530dd634fe8302b55d4a0669463ef733199cc40/README.md) preserves the reproduction and the superseded PR text. Existing test passes and local eligibility below do not waive the newly found defect. Parent merge and independent authorized architect approval still remain.

Candidate **[0ff3f6cd](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502)** (`0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502`), stacked on `122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58`. Complete-candidate selection compares main `9d0546b93d37e74ee9ddc7d9f7f4a66b18de0546`. [Full validation, commands, and limits](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/VALIDATION.md) · [exact counts](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/validation.json) · [retained logs](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/checks).

| Selected check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npm test` | PASS: 4,920 backend + 49 portal |
| `npm run typecheck`; `npm run build:user-portal` | PASS |
| New/changed compiled focus | PASS: 95 |
| `npm run test:logging:postgres` | PASS: 22, including overlap and three real crash/restart points |
| `npm run test:hosted-live` | PASS: 28 against staging, including real token expiry |
| `npm run test:logging:collector` | PASS: 10 |
| `npm run test:container` | PASS on retry: 11 |
| `npm run test:container:hosted` | PASS: seven on Linux AMD64; includes offline `build:hosted` |
| API snapshots; manual links/diff/SQL privileges | PASS: 49 snapshots; API roles denied; scoped runtime grants/RLS verified locally |

Passing Node summaries have zero fail/cancelled/skipped/todo tests. The ordinary gated container suite registers no cases; the explicit 11-case run is its proof. No redundant standalone `npm run check` was added.

BDD acceptance and focused tests failed before source implementation. The independent provider-read deadline finding reproduced 6 integration + 10 unit failures, then passed with stop propagation. Initial full/type checks failed on a fixture type and passed after correction. Initial self-hosted tests failed 0/11 with Docker `ENOSPC`; removing only old stopped Thermus test edge/image artifacts allowed the 11/11 retry. No database volume was removed. Native metrics initially refused a dirty candidate; committing resolved that prerequisite. Earlier failures and red/green steps remain in the linked record.

Coverage used already-selected unit/integration/acceptance suites: 3,205+29, 1,080, and 571+20 cases, all passing. Final process reuses verified compatible capture across a prose-only commit. The final type-only move left all 177 emitted production JS files identical; the later source change altered only two explanatory comment lines. [Source equivalence](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/checks/final-source-equivalence.json) and [coverage provenance](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/metrics/coverage.json) state the limits. No metric report was edited.

GitHub returned no check/status contexts for this exact head; no separate remote CI pass is claimed. Additional live removal, browser, restore, Supabase owner checks, and release remain later slices. No new paid resource, production migration, or production deletion. The Supabase scaffold hit a missing inherited profile; a local migration file and disposable PostgreSQL proof were used without bypassing controls.

Final checker: **T2 / locally eligible**, no local blockers. Overall merge remains blocked by parent #251 and independent human architect approval. [Quality review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/253#issuecomment-6395531599).

[Canonical checker](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/metrics/pr-review.json) · [full quality dispositions](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/QUALITY.md) · [complete process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/metrics/process.md) · [all machine reports](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/metrics).

Tier reasons: one public module, three changed declarations, and two added/five edited registry views; deployment/component/internalInterface flags. T1 reasons remain: review-rules policy path; exceptions/test-gate read paths; three used MI exceptions; sensitiveBehavior/policy flags. The impact is the increment against #251, while full candidate checks cover main.

Policy answers: register the public removal contract and extend the existing PostgreSQL gate; do not weaken checks or change who approves. No browser/client removal contract ships here. The internal operation returns explicit refusal/unknown results and owns a fixed deadline. Operator activation requires the additive table with existing credentials/pool, no new env/key/resource, and retention of unknown holds. MFA and MCP rules remain unchanged. No authorized decision maker required an ADR for this planned implementation.

The final metric process completed all stages. Delta/Review retain goal misses; CRAP retains one mapping limit; Architecture passes. The checker applies the trusted incremental goals. Three new-file MI exceptions expire **2026-12-24**: coordinator **43.6799 ≥ 43.67**, checks **56.8902 ≥ 56.89**, lifetime **73.5001 ≥ 73.50**. They keep ordered admission/receipt rules, current-fact/last-Admin rules, and one deadline owner together; largest functions have 9/9/4 paths. [Inspection and reasons](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/review/coordinator-quality.md).

All measured new/changed functions meet CRAP goals (maximum 9). `composeLoggingStorage` remains unmapped; one path bounds CRAP to **[1, 2]**, which the checker proves within goal. It is not claimed as measured coverage. No CRAP exception or altered report is used.

Every informational note is addressed in [QUALITY.md](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/QUALITY.md): 49 public modules/three changed snapshots/one addition; unchanged declarations in index, overview, and customer-role callers; **2449** total-line note versus **384** production lines; pg MI **53.64→46.32**; high lifetime/coordinator MI and full-stack WorkOS/pg findings. The pg adapter keeps short atomic operations on one bounded runtime; WorkOS keeps guards at each existing read. Other low scores, medium/low findings, and the unchanged parent integration-test finding retain specific reasons. Inherited full tables are not repeated here.

Final habit-hooks exits 1 with reviewed retained findings: 1 complexity, 4 parameter counts, 302 comments, 13 sizes. [All 320 dispositions](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/review/habit-dispositions.md) and [line inventory](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e87fa04a948f840ea021c2f83797b774fbd4ec86/review-evidence/s2-5-01b/0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502/review/habit-inventory.json) cover all 43 files. The stale unknown-outcome comment was corrected; snooze stays `[]`. No unresolved correction remains.
